speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the onset and progression of your gait and limb ataxia, and do you have any other neurological symptoms like numbness, weakness, or speech difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see, so the clumsiness is notably worse on your right side. Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision, or any difficulty with speaking or swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent natalizumab use, I am concerned about the possibility of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). Do you have any cognitive changes, such as memory loss or confusion, and have you had a recent MRI of your brain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Your symptoms, combined with your natalizumab use, strongly suggest Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy. REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI
